title: Mahavir Singh v. U.P. Power Corporation Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Tarun Agarwala, J.; Amar Singh Chauhan, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed on laches; bill dispute relegated to clause 6.5.
headnote: A belated writ against U.P. Power Corporation Ltd. was dismissed on laches. Any dispute relating to the bill may be raised by an application under paragraph 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: Mahavir Singh and twenty others filed a writ petition in the Allahabad High Court against U.P. Power Corporation Ltd., through its Chairman and two other officers. The petition came up before a Division Bench in 2015. After hearing counsel for the petitioners, the Court treated the challenge as belated. It declined to entertain the writ and left any bill-related grievance to the statutory mechanism under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.holding: A writ petition filed at a belated stage is liable to be dismissed on laches; any dispute relating to the bill may be raised by an application under paragraph 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

not_decided.note: The Court did not examine the bill; it dismissed the writ on laches and pointed to paragraph 6.5.
